newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan vegoil prices seen down amid low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan vegoil prices seen down amid low demand.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil prices are likely to fall in the next trading week amid low demand ahead of the budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June) to be announced on June 14, dealers said on Saturday.
They said the sale of 4,622 tonnes of imported RBD palm oil by the state-run Ghee Corporation of Pakistan through auction on Thursday has also dampened demand for further imports.
Dealer Kamran Siddiqui of Saulat Enterprise said imports were likely to remain low ahead of the budget amid speculation that the government may change vegetable-oil import duties.
